title: Nice when turned ON light bulb gets very hot ..worries me.
text: Nice when turned ON light bulb gets very hot ..worries me.. This looks nice when turned ON. I like the fire sound but it’s too low ..so you don’t really hear it.  I don’t like the humming sound it makes ..not good. The light bulb gets too hot and makes the plastic wood very hot also and it worries me.  I do enjoy looking at this fake log inside my fireplace when it is turned ON. I hope this is safe to use all day long because the light bulb which gets very hot ..worries me a lot.

description: The Pleasant Hearth 20 in. Electric Fireplace Logs can be inserted into any fireplace, replacing existing wood grate, gas grate, burner or log set. Easy to install, this unit plugs into any 120 volt outlet to bring you the look, sound and feel of a real fire in a safe and clean alternative. Complete the look with the Pleasant Hearth Grate Front GF-20 (sold separately).
